scoreBreakdown.reason: [desktop-cta-pairing] Primary and secondary hero CTAs share equal visual weight; scan path still lands on account creation but secondary link could defer further on wide layouts. [desktop-midpage-interrupt] For-your-AI block appears before feature grid and pulls attention away from the signup column on first scroll. [mobile-auth-below-fold] On 390px capture the Create free account card sits well below hero CTAs, adding scroll before users reach the inline sign-in form. [mobile-length] Marketing story is very long on mobile; final CTA band is far from hero, increasing fatigue before repeat conversion.

topIssues: Long mobile scroll to footer CTA
quickWins: Anchor mobile users to #get-started after primary hero CTA tap
